content.json:
# MomentLens - pipeline cost and latency

Custom metrics emitted by the API for every indexing run (Application Insights `customMetrics`):

* **`momentlens.pipeline.runs`** - counter, one per run (succeeded or failed)
* **`momentlens.pipeline.latency_seconds`** - histogram, wall-clock time of a run
* **`momentlens.pipeline.cost_usd`** - histogram, estimated cost of a run in USD (list prices configured in the API)
* **`momentlens.pipeline.scene_count`** - histogram, scene cards produced by a run

Dimensions: `content_type`, `status`.

The last section reads the console log of the `vi-poller` Container Apps job from the Log Analytics workspace selected below (table `ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL`, which exists after the first job run).

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'momentlens.pipeline.runs'
| extend status = tostring(customDimensions.status), content_type = tostring(customDimensions.content_type)
| summarize Runs = sum(valueSum) by status, content_type
| order by status asc, content_type asc
content.title: Runs by status

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'momentlens.pipeline.cost_usd'
| extend content_type = tostring(customDimensions.content_type)
| summarize TotalUSD = round(sum(valueSum), 4), Runs = sum(valueCount), AvgPerRun = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 4) by content_type
| order by content_type asc
content.title: Estimated cost (USD) by content type

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'momentlens.pipeline.latency_seconds'
| summarize avg_s = avg(valueSum / valueCount), p95_s = percentile(valueSum / valueCount, 95) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Pipeline latency over time (seconds)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'momentlens.pipeline.cost_usd'
| extend content_type = tostring(customDimensions.content_type)
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), content_type
| render columnchart
content.title: Estimated cost (USD) per hour

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'momentlens.pipeline.scene_count'
| extend content_type = tostring(customDimensions.content_type)
| summarize Scenes = sum(valueSum), Runs = sum(valueCount), AvgScenesPerRun = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 1) by content_type
| order by content_type asc
content.title: Scene cards per run

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has 'telemetry: status='
| project timestamp, message
| top 100 by timestamp desc
content.title: Per-run log lines (most recent first)

content.json:
## vi-poller job

The `vi-poller` Container Apps job waits for Video Indexer to finish a video and stores the insights in Blob Storage. Its output is read from the workspace selected above.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Job = coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerGroupName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerJobName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))
| where Job startswith 'ml-vi-poller'
| where Log_s has_any ('VI state', 'PromptContent', 'vi-poller')
| project TimeGenerated, Execution = column_ifexists('ContainerGroupName_s', ''), Log_s
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent vi-poller progress

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Job = coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerGroupName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerJobName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))
| where Job startswith 'ml-vi-poller'
| where Log_s has_any ('ERROR', 'Failed', 'Traceback', 'crashed')
| project TimeGenerated, Execution = column_ifexists('ContainerGroupName_s', ''), Log_s
| top 200 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent vi-poller errors
